entries.title: agent_conversations
entries.summary: Actor-owned corporate agent conversation with capability-specific validated context and a bounded execution lease.

entries.title: agent_turn_traces
entries.summary: Optional content-level AI trace of one turn, written only when IA_MNS_AI_TRACE=content: model/prompt identifiers, timings and token counts, routing and interpretation decisions, structured conversation state before and after, and the executed query filters. Never result rows, response prose, credentials or provider payloads. Used to reproduce failures and derive evaluation candidates.

entries.title: agent_turns
entries.summary: One user message and its execution lifecycle, real progress, and versioned assistant outcome. Failed/interrupted turns retain no fabricated answer.

entries.title: identity_audit_events
entries.summary: Append-only audit of security-relevant identity events: sign-in outcomes, provisioning, link and unlink, credential and factor changes, role and grant changes, session revocation and bootstrap.

entries.title: identity_capability_grants
entries.summary: Explicit capability permissions granted to a Person by an owner, united with group grants. External links alone grant no permission. A grant may be narrowed by data restrictions (identity_grant_restrictions); an explicit grant takes precedence over the provider policy for its permission. The language model never creates grants.

entries.title: identity_external_identities
entries.summary: A link between a Person and one stable external account (PDT Connect identitySubject or Sankhya CODUSU) under a fixed issuer, created from a server-verified proof by the account holder or by an owner selecting the account in the Sankhya directory.

entries.title: identity_grant_restrictions
entries.summary: Data restrictions of a Person's explicit grant (ADR-0037): each row admits one value of one dimension. Values of a dimension are alternatives; every restricted dimension of the grant must match. A grant without rows admits every row of its source.

entries.title: identity_group_grant_restrictions
entries.summary: Data restrictions of a group grant, with the same meaning as identity_grant_restrictions.

entries.title: identity_group_grants
entries.summary: Permissions an owner granted to a group, optionally narrowed by identity_group_grant_restrictions; every member holds them.

entries.title: identity_group_members
entries.summary: Membership of a Person in a group; the member holds the group's grants.

entries.title: identity_groups
entries.summary: Owner-managed groups of Persons (ADR-0037). Every member holds the group's grants, united with its own grants.

entries.title: identity_local_credentials
entries.summary: Optional IA-MNS local sign-in: unique login, memory-hard password verifier, lockout state and encrypted TOTP secret for strong authentication.

entries.title: identity_persons
entries.summary: An IA-MNS Person: the single internal identity that owns conversations, preferences, links, credentials, roles and grants, independent of the surface or method used to sign in.

entries.title: identity_provider_groups
entries.summary: Owner-selected default group for each external sign-in provider; no implicit permission policy.

entries.title: identity_recovery_codes
entries.summary: Single-use second-factor recovery codes, stored only as SHA-256 hashes of high-entropy values shown once.

entries.title: identity_role_assignments
entries.summary: Internal IA-MNS roles assigned to a Person. owner is the principal administrator with full IA-MNS capability and administration, independent of Sankhya or PDT roles.

entries.title: identity_security_policies
entries.summary: The single owner-administered authentication policy: session lifetime, inactivity timeout, recent-authentication windows, second-factor requirement and remembered browsers. Absent row means the built-in secure defaults.

entries.title: identity_sessions
entries.summary: Authenticated continuity for a Person: method, surface, assurance and expiry. Direct-URL sessions hold a rotating refresh credential (hash only); embedded sessions have none and renew through a new host proof.

entries.title: identity_tickets
entries.summary: Short-lived single-use flow state addressed by the SHA-256 of a high-entropy secret: bootstrap, enrollment, reset and link invitations, pending second factor, pending TOTP setup, provisioning choice, profile consolidation, and pending PDT or Sankhya proofs (state, nonce, PKCE verifier).

entries.title: identity_trusted_devices
entries.summary: A browser that completed the second factor for a Person and asked to be remembered; its HttpOnly cookie holds a random token stored here only as SHA-256.

entries.title: identity_used_assertions
entries.summary: Replay protection for host identity assertions: SHA-256 of each accepted assertion jti until it expires.

entries.title: identity_whatsapp_links
entries.summary: The WhatsApp number that an owner linked to a Person: the only authorization of the WhatsApp channel. An external identity attribute of an existing Person, never a sign-in method; it grants no permission by itself.

entries.title: operational_parameters
entries.summary: Values that owners saved for the operational parameters declared by the runtime catalog in apps/api/src/parameters.ts (ADR-0028). The catalog owns each parameter's type, domain, installation default and effect; a missing row or a null value means the installation default applies. Secrets and bootstrap settings are never stored here.

entries.title: whatsapp_inbound_messages
entries.summary: WhatsApp messages from senders that matched exactly one active Person through an owner-linked number when the signature-verified webhook arrived. Unknown, unlinked or unauthorized senders are never recorded. Each row is processed once, in order per Person, after the sender is authorized again.

entries.title: whatsapp_outbound_messages
entries.summary: Replies to inbound WhatsApp messages: an outbox of text parts sent through the Graph API only after the recipient is authorized again for the same Person and link version, and only within the customer service window.

entries.title: whatsapp_threads
entries.summary: Per-Person WhatsApp channel state: the agent conversation that new messages continue and the sales source the person chose with a command.

entries.title: Button
entries.summary: A themed native button with consistent action hierarchy and pending feedback.

entries.title: ConversationMaterials
entries.summary: Manages owned operational attachments and explicit presentation preferences within one conversation.

entries.title: ErrorNotice
entries.summary: Displays a public API failure message and an optional reload action.

entries.title: PageHeader
entries.summary: A page title and description with optional back navigation and primary actions.

entries.title: ProductAnswer
entries.summary: Presents the products a lookup found in the Pilar da Terra (VR Master) registration with how each criterion was understood.

entries.title: ProductOptions
entries.summary: Presents the numbered choices of a product clarification, such as two interpretations of a word or several matching buyers.

entries.title: SalesAnswer
entries.summary: Presents a sales answer with one labeled section per queried source: MNS (Sankhya), Pilar da Terra (VR Master) or both.

entries.title: SalesResults
entries.summary: Presents validated sales aggregates of one source, distinct units, comparisons and matched products.

entries.title: SectionCard
entries.summary: A named section with a consistent heading, optional description and decorative icon.

entries.title: SelectField
entries.summary: A themed native select with an associated label, help and validation messages.

entries.title: StatusBadge
entries.summary: A compact textual label for a state or category.

entries.title: TextField
entries.summary: A labeled text-like input with associated help and validation messages.
